invariants.rationale: Result is always a string of 8 hex digits for #RRGGBBAA per conversion.
Input must be non-null, and result is always non-null.
tiledColor always starts with # and the output is 8 hex digits.
Tiled input color is either #RRGGBB (7) or #AARRGGBB (9).
The color (without alpha) part is always transferred to the first 6 chars of result.
